lessons.title: Register
lessons.tip: At C2, the right word depends on who you're talking to. «Commence» suits a contract; «kick off» suits a team chat.

exercises.prompt: Which is the most appropriate opening for a formal complaint letter?
options: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with…
I just wanted to say I'm pretty annoyed about…
Hey, so here's the thing about…
exercises.answer: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with…

exercises.prompt: Match each formal verb with its informal equivalent.

exercises.sentence: Passengers are kindly requested to ___ from smoking on the platform.
Should you ___ any further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite formally: «We didn't get your payment.»
exercises.answer: We have yet to receive your payment.

exercises.text: Under no circumstances should the door be left unlocked
options: Under no circumstances should the door be left unlocked
In no circumstances the door should be left unlocked
Under some circumstances the door should be unlocked
exercises.answer: Under no circumstances should the door be left unlocked

options: Seldom have I seen such dedication.
Seldom I have seen such dedication.
Seldom have I saw such dedication.
exercises.answer: Seldom have I seen such dedication.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite with inversion, starting «Not only»: «She speaks Mandarin and she also teaches it.»
exercises.answer: Not only does she speak Mandarin, but she also teaches it
alternatives: Not only does she speak Mandarin but she also teaches it
Not only does she speak Mandarin, she also teaches it
Not only does she speak Mandarin, but she teaches it too

lessons.title: Shades of meaning
lessons.tip: Near-synonyms carry different connotations: «frugal» praises, «stingy» criticises — yet both mean you spend little.

exercises.prompt: Which adjective is the most positive way of describing someone who spends little?

exercises.sentence: The minister's ___ reply gave journalists nothing to work with.
He was accused of ___ the rules by parking in the disabled bay every single day.

exercises.text: Her argument, though eloquent, was ultimately specious
exercises.answer: Her argument, though eloquent, was ultimately specious

options: seems plausible but is actually wrong
exercises.answer: seems plausible but is actually wrong

exercises.prompt: Su silencio no implica necesariamente que esté de acuerdo.
exercises.answer: Her silence does not necessarily imply consent.
